title: Common Intention
content: When a criminal act is done by several persons in furtherance of common intention, each person is liable as if the act were done individually.
cases: Mahbub Shah v Emperor

title: Abetment
content: A person abets an offence by instigating, engaging in conspiracy, or intentionally aiding the commission of an offence.
cases: Ramesh Kumar v State of Chhattisgarh

title: Criminal Conspiracy
content: Agreement between two or more persons to commit an illegal act constitutes criminal conspiracy.
cases: State v Nalini

title: Unlawful Assembly
content: An assembly of five or more persons with a common unlawful object is an unlawful assembly.

title: Culpable Homicide
content: Whoever causes death with intention or knowledge commits culpable homicide.
cases: State of AP v Rayavarapu Punnayya

title: Murder
content: Culpable homicide is murder if the act is done with intention to cause death.
cases: Virsa Singh v State of Punjab

title: Punishment for Murder
content: Whoever commits murder shall be punished with death or imprisonment for life.
cases: Bachan Singh v State of Punjab

title: Causing Death by Negligence
content: Causing death by rash or negligent act not amounting to culpable homicide is punishable.
cases: Jacob Mathew v State of Punjab

title: Attempt to Murder
content: Whoever attempts to commit murder shall be punished.

title: Voluntarily Causing Hurt
content: Whoever voluntarily causes hurt shall be punished.

title: Outraging Modesty of Woman
content: Assault or criminal force with intent to outrage modesty of a woman.
cases: State v Major Singh

title: Rape
content: Punishment for rape as defined under IPC.
cases: Mukesh v State (Nirbhaya)

title: Theft
content: Dishonest removal of movable property out of possession of any person.

title: Robbery
content: Theft accompanied by violence or fear of instant death.

title: Cheating
content: Cheating and dishonestly inducing delivery of property.
cases: Hridaya Ranjan v State of Bihar

title: Arrest without Warrant
content: Police may arrest without warrant in cognizable offences.
cases: DK Basu v State of West Bengal

title: Grounds of Arrest
content: Person arrested must be informed of the grounds of arrest.

title: First Information Report (FIR)
content: Information relating to cognizable offence shall be recorded as FIR.
cases: Lalita Kumari v Govt of UP

title: Anticipatory Bail
content: High Court or Sessions Court may grant bail before arrest.
cases: Gurbaksh Singh v State of Punjab

title: Right to Life and Personal Liberty
content: No person shall be deprived of life or personal liberty except according to procedure established by law.
cases: Maneka Gandhi v Union of India

title: Punishment for Theft
content: Whoever commits theft shall be punished with imprisonment up to three years, or fine, or both.

title: Punishment for Robbery
content: Whoever commits robbery shall be punished with rigorous imprisonment up to ten years and fine.

title: Dacoity
content: When five or more persons commit robbery, it is called dacoity.

title: Criminal Breach of Trust
content: Dishonest misappropriation or conversion of entrusted property.

title: Criminal Breach of Trust by Public Servant
content: Breach of trust committed by public servant, banker, merchant or agent.

title: Forgery
content: Making false document with intent to cause damage or fraud.

title: Forgery for Purpose of Cheating
content: Forgery committed for the purpose of cheating.

title: Using Forged Document
content: Using as genuine a forged document knowing it to be forged.

title: Defamation
content: Making or publishing any imputation harming reputation of a person.
cases: Subramanian Swamy v Union of India

title: Punishment for Defamation
content: Punishment for defamation is simple imprisonment up to two years, or fine, or both.

title: Procedure when Investigation not Completed
content: Magistrate may authorize detention if investigation is incomplete within 24 hours.
cases: CBI v Anupam Kulkarni

title: Police Report (Charge Sheet)
content: Police shall submit final report after completing investigation.

title: Cognizance of Offences by Magistrate
content: Magistrate may take cognizance upon complaint, police report or information.

title: Examination of Complainant
content: Magistrate shall examine complainant upon receiving complaint.

title: Examination of Accused
content: Court shall question accused to explain evidence against him.

title: Confession caused by inducement
content: Confession caused by threat, promise or inducement is irrelevant.

title: Dying Declaration
content: Statement made by person as to cause of death is relevant.
cases: Pakala Narayana Swami Case

title: Opinion of Experts
content: Opinions of experts in science, art or handwriting are relevant.

title: Equality Before Law
content: State shall not deny equality before law or equal protection of laws.
cases: Indra Sawhney v Union of India

title: Freedom of Speech and Expression
content: All citizens shall have the right to freedom of speech and expression.
cases: Shreya Singhal v Union of India

title: Cruelty by Husband or Relatives
content: Husband or relative subjecting a married woman to cruelty shall be punished.
cases: Arnesh Kumar v State of Bihar

title: Word or Gesture Insulting Modesty
content: Uttering words or gestures intended to insult the modesty of a woman.

title: Criminal Intimidation
content: Threatening another with injury to person, reputation or property.

title: Attempt to Commit Offences
content: Punishment for attempting to commit offences punishable with imprisonment.

title: Maintenance of Wife, Children and Parents
content: Magistrate may order maintenance for wife, children or parents unable to maintain themselves.
cases: Shah Bano Case

title: Commitment to Sessions Court
content: Cases triable by Sessions Court shall be committed by Magistrate.

title: Discharge of Accused
content: Magistrate may discharge accused if charge is groundless.

title: Compounding of Offences
content: Certain offences may be compounded by parties with or without court permission.

title: Right to Constitutional Remedies
content: Right to approach Supreme Court for enforcement of Fundamental Rights.
cases: Kesavananda Bharati v State of Kerala

title: Power of High Courts to Issue Writs
content: High Courts may issue writs for enforcement of fundamental rights and other purposes.

title: Penalty for Damage to Computer
content: Unauthorized access, downloading or introducing virus to computer system is punishable.

title: Computer Related Offences
content: If any person dishonestly or fraudulently commits acts under Section 43, punishment applies.

title: Publishing Obscene Material Online
content: Publishing or transmitting obscene material in electronic form is punishable.

title: Prohibition of Certain Operations
content: Production, possession, sale, purchase or transport of narcotic drugs is prohibited.

title: Punishment for Manufactured Drugs
content: Punishment for contravention relating to manufactured drugs and preparations.

title: Penetrative Sexual Assault
content: Defines penetrative sexual assault against a child.

title: Punishment for Penetrative Sexual Assault
content: Punishment for penetrative sexual assault on a child.

title: Burden of Proof
content: Whoever desires court to give judgment as to legal right must prove facts asserted.

title: Presumption of Existence of Facts
content: Court may presume existence of certain facts based on common course of events.

title: Definition of Consumer
content: Consumer means any person who buys goods or hires services for consideration.

title: Filing of Complaint
content: A consumer may file a complaint before the District Commission.

title: Procedure on Admission of Complaint
content: District Commission shall refer complaint copy to opposite party.

title: Courts to Try All Civil Suits
content: Civil courts have jurisdiction to try all suits of civil nature unless barred.

title: Particulars in Plaint
content: Plaint must contain material facts and cause of action.

title: Temporary Injunction
content: Court may grant temporary injunction to prevent damage or injury.

title: Duty of Driver in Case of Accident
content: Driver must take reasonable steps to secure medical attention for injured person.

title: Insurance Against Third Party Risk
content: No person shall use vehicle without insurance policy.

title: Application for Compensation
content: Application for compensation arising from accident may be filed.

title: Definition of Company
content: Company means a company incorporated under this Act.

title: Formation of Company
content: A company may be formed for any lawful purpose.

title: Punishment for Fraud
content: Fraud under Companies Act is punishable with imprisonment and fine.

title: Divorce
content: Marriage may be dissolved on grounds like cruelty, adultery, desertion.

title: Devolution of Interest in Coparcenary Property
content: Daughters have equal rights in coparcenary property.
cases: Vineeta Sharma v Rakesh Sharma

title: What Agreements are Contracts
content: Agreements enforceable by law are contracts if made by free consent.

title: Compensation for Breach
content: Party suffering breach is entitled to compensation.

title: General Duties of Occupier
content: Occupier shall ensure health and safety of workers.

title: Payment of Minimum Wages
content: Employer shall pay wages not less than minimum rates fixed.

title: Right to Information
content: All citizens shall have the right to information under this Act.

title: Request for Obtaining Information
content: A person may make a request in writing to the Public Information Officer.

title: Arbitration Agreement
content: Arbitration agreement means an agreement to submit disputes to arbitration.

title: Application for Setting Aside Arbitral Award
content: Court may set aside arbitral award on limited grounds.

title: Power of Central Government
content: Central Government may take measures to protect environment.

law: Air (Prevention and Control of Pollution) Act, 1981
title: Consent to Establish
content: No person shall establish industry without consent of State Board.

title: Levy and Collection
content: GST shall be levied on supply of goods or services.

title: Input Tax Credit
content: Registered person shall be entitled to take credit of input tax.

title: Power of RBI to Issue Directions
content: Reserve Bank may issue directions to banking companies.

title: Initiation of CIRP by Financial Creditor
content: Financial creditor may file application to initiate insolvency process.

law: Protection of Women from Domestic Violence Act, 2005
title: Application to Magistrate
content: Aggrieved woman may present application to Magistrate for relief.

title: Extension of Prescribed Period
content: Court may condone delay if sufficient cause is shown.

title: Appeal from Original Decree
content: Appeal shall lie from every decree passed by any court exercising original jurisdiction.

title: Functions of Commission
content: National Human Rights Commission shall inquire into violation of human rights.

title: Public Servant Taking Bribe
content: Public servant taking undue advantage is punishable.

title: Offence of Money Laundering
content: Whosoever directly or indirectly attempts to indulge in money laundering commits offence.

title: Child in Conflict with Law
content: A child alleged or found to have committed an offence and who has not completed eighteen years of age.

title: Sale of Immovable Property
content: Sale is transfer of ownership in exchange for price paid or promised.

title: Specific Performance of Contract
content: Specific performance may be enforced when monetary compensation is inadequate.
